accepted.text: Today Instance (YC S26) is launching and showcasing their success detector for robot policies. The article points readers to demo.instancelabs.ai and names Instance founders Claire Mao and Lucy Cai.
attributionSignals: LinkedIn JSON-LD names Ankit Gupta as the author and links the author profile to https://www.linkedin.com/in/ankitvgupta.
LinkedIn JSON-LD exposes 99 likes and 7 comments for the article.
Article body names Instance (YC S26), demo.instancelabs.ai, Claire Mao, and Lucy Cai.
src/lib/yc/summer-2026-companies.json lists Instance in Summer 2026 with founders Claire Mao and Lucy Cai.
accepted.reason: Accepted: new native LinkedIn article by a seeded YC partner with direct S26 company/founder/domain mentions and visible metrics; URL was not present in prior evidence files.
